name: fp8-kv4-modelrunner-screen-v1
scope: Descriptive matched eager ModelRunner timing; not HTTP serving or model-quality qualification
runtime: Same authenticated private SGLang 0.5.21 composition for both arms
prompt_policy: Exact frozen no-template token vectors; distinct C2 counterparts; identical bytes in both arms
cache_policy: Fresh private compiler/cache directories per arm; request/cache release and reset after every batch; no accepted cache purge or reuse

timing.clock: Host monotonic wall with GPU synchronization before and after each operation
included: existing adapter copies, validation and synchronization
timing.rank_aggregation: Maximum rank time for each aligned operation
timing.warmups: Retained separately, excluded only from warm-sample statistics
timing.lazy_compilation: Any compilation within a measured operation remains included

interpretation: One fixed-order two-load screen, not an independent-start speed ranking. Compare output scores only for matching tokens and conditioning histories.
physical_blocker: CPU-tested host-process owner adapter exists; an authenticated live read-only platform observer and fresh physical controller/grant bindings are still required. Native Linux ownership and GPU release are unrun.
